meaning.en: To ignore even close relatives; to be ruthless and cold.
meaning.zh: 连亲人都不认，形容冷酷无情，不讲情面。

equivalents: not even recognise one's own family

examples.zh: 一提到钱，他就六亲不认。
examples.en: When money comes up, he'd disown his own family.

examples.zh: 她办事六亲不认，谁来求情都没用。
examples.en: She plays everything by the book, and no appeal for favours works on her.

usage.en: Predicate; can be critical or, about strict officials, admiring.
usage.zh: 作谓语；多含贬义，也可形容执法严格，不讲情面。

meaning.en: To think oneself unique and admire oneself, aloof from others.
meaning.zh: 自认为清高出众，独自欣赏自己。

examples.zh: 他孤芳自赏，不愿与同事来往。
examples.en: He's aloof and conceited, and avoids his colleagues.

examples.zh: 作品不能只是孤芳自赏，要让读者喜欢。
examples.en: Writing can't just please its author; it has to win readers.

usage.en: Predicate; critical.
usage.zh: 作谓语，含贬义。

natural: only you know how it feels

meaning.en: Only the person involved truly knows how they fare.
meaning.zh: 如人饮水，冷暖自知：个中滋味只有自己清楚。

examples.zh: 婚姻好不好，冷暖自知。
examples.en: Whether a marriage is happy, only those inside it know.

examples.zh: 创业的甘苦，冷暖自知。
examples.en: The hardships of starting a business are known only to oneself.

usage.en: Predicate; often in the saying 如人饮水，冷暖自知.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常出现在“如人饮水，冷暖自知”中。

meaning.en: A disaster that comes out of the blue, through no fault of one's own.
meaning.zh: 没有料到、无辜遭受的灾祸。

examples.zh: 他无故被卷入官司，纯属无妄之灾。
examples.en: He was dragged into a lawsuit for no reason, a sheer misfortune.

examples.zh: 别人的失误让我遭了无妄之灾。
examples.en: Someone else's mistake brought disaster on me.

story.en: I Ching, hexagram Wuwang, third line: 'Undeserved misfortune: an ox tethered…' (无妄之灾，或系之牛).
story.zh: 《周易》：“无妄之灾，或系之牛，行人之得，邑人之灾。”

usage.en: Object; often 遭受/飞来无妄之灾.
usage.zh: 作宾语，常说“遭受无妄之灾”。

pinyin: cháng jiāng hòu làng tuī qián làng
literal: Yangtze · back · waves · push · front · waves
natural: the waves behind drive on the waves ahead

meaning.en: The younger generation keeps overtaking the old; progress is constant.
meaning.zh: 长江里后面的浪不断推着前面的浪，比喻新人不断超越旧人，事物不断向前发展。

equivalents: the new generation replaces the old
each wave drives the one before

examples.zh: 长江后浪推前浪，年轻人迟早会超过我们。
examples.en: The new generation presses on the old, and young people will overtake us sooner or later.

examples.zh: 老教授笑着说：“长江后浪推前浪，你们要超过我。”
examples.en: The old professor said with a smile, 'The waves behind push those ahead; you must surpass me.'

usage.en: Saying; often followed by 一代新人换旧人 or 一浪更比一浪强.
usage.zh: 俗语，常接“一代新人换旧人”或“一浪更比一浪强”。

meaning.en: An implied meaning beyond the literal words.
meaning.zh: 话里没有明说、需要领会的意思。

examples.zh: 听得出他话里有弦外之音。
examples.en: You could tell there was more to his words than they said.

examples.zh: 这首诗的弦外之音值得细细品味。
examples.en: The unspoken meaning of this poem is worth savouring.

usage.en: Object; often 听出/品出弦外之音.
usage.zh: 作宾语，常说“听出弦外之音”。

meaning.en: Concrete, reliable evidence.
meaning.zh: 确实可靠的证据。

examples.zh: 没有真凭实据，不能随便指控别人。
examples.en: You can't accuse people without hard evidence.

examples.zh: 警方已掌握了真凭实据。
examples.en: The police now have solid proof.

usage.en: Object; often 拿出/掌握真凭实据.
usage.zh: 作宾语，常说“拿出真凭实据”。

meaning.en: How people treat you depends on your fortune: warmly when you thrive, coldly when you fail.
meaning.zh: 别人对待自己的态度，随自己得势或失势而时热时冷。

equivalents: the ups and downs of human kindness

examples.zh: 经历了这场变故，他看透了人情冷暖。
examples.en: After the upheaval he saw how fickle people could be.

examples.zh: 人情冷暖，世态炎凉，她都体会过。
examples.en: She has felt both the warmth and coldness of people.

usage.en: Object; often 看透/尝尽人情冷暖.
usage.zh: 作宾语，常说“看透人情冷暖”。

meaning.en: A dissolute person who turns over a new leaf.
meaning.zh: 不务正业的人醒悟悔改，走上正路。

equivalents: the prodigal turns over a new leaf

examples.zh: 他浪子回头，如今开了家小店。
examples.en: He mended his ways and now runs a small shop.

examples.zh: 浪子回头，大家都该给他机会。
examples.en: A wastrel who turns back deserves a chance.

usage.en: Predicate; the full saying is 浪子回头金不换.
usage.zh: 作谓语；完整俗语是“浪子回头金不换”。

meaning.en: The moral state of society and the hearts of its people.
meaning.zh: 社会风气和人们的思想道德状况。

examples.zh: 这部小说针砭世道人心。
examples.en: The novel takes aim at the moral climate of the times.

examples.zh: 他常感叹世道人心不古。
examples.en: He often laments the decline of social morals.

usage.en: Noun phrase; used in commentary.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，常见于评论。

meaning.en: To flatter and fawn on people in order to please them.
meaning.zh: 用好听的话迎合讨好别人。

examples.zh: 他靠阿谀奉承得到了老板的青睐。
examples.en: He won the boss's favour by fawning.

examples.zh: 我最讨厌阿谀奉承的人。
examples.en: I can't stand sycophants.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: Giving up one's own interests or life for others or a cause.
meaning.zh: 为了别人或事业而舍弃自己的利益甚至生命。

examples.zh: 母亲的自我牺牲让这个家得以维持。
examples.en: The mother's self-sacrifice kept the family going.

examples.zh: 消防员的自我牺牲精神令人敬佩。
examples.en: Firefighters' spirit of self-sacrifice is admirable.

usage.en: Noun phrase; often 自我牺牲精神.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，常说“自我牺牲精神”。

meaning.en: Bright sky and clean, fresh air.
meaning.zh: 天空晴朗，空气清新。

examples.zh: 秋日天朗气清，最适合登高。
examples.en: Autumn days are clear and crisp, best for climbing a hill.

examples.zh: 雨后天朗气清，空气格外新鲜。
examples.en: After rain the sky was clear and the air especially fresh.

story.en: Wang Xizhi's 'Preface to the Orchid Pavilion': 'This day the sky was bright and the air clear, the breeze mild' (是日也，天朗气清，惠风和畅).
story.zh: 《兰亭集序》：“是日也，天朗气清，惠风和畅。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语。

literal: three · down · five · divide out · two

meaning.en: Quickly and briskly; with no fuss.
meaning.zh: 形容动作利落、迅速（原是珠算口诀）。

examples.zh: 他三下五除二就把箱子打包好了。
examples.en: He had the box packed in no time.

examples.zh: 几个人三下五除二，把问题解决了。
examples.en: A few of them made short work of the problem.

usage.en: Adverbial; from the abacus formula for division.
usage.zh: 多作状语；原为珠算除法口诀。

meaning.en: Having a glib tongue, able to talk people round.
meaning.zh: 舌头像笛簧一样灵巧，形容能说会道、善于狡辩。

examples.zh: 别被他巧舌如簧的话骗了。
examples.en: Don't be taken in by his silver-tongued talk.

examples.zh: 推销员巧舌如簧，说得人心动。
examples.en: The salesman was so glib that people were tempted.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; critical.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，含贬义。

meaning.en: Too weak or absurd to deserve a reply.
meaning.zh: 毫无道理，不值得反驳。

examples.zh: 这种说法漏洞百出，不值一驳。
examples.en: The claim is full of holes and isn't worth rebutting.

examples.zh: 他的指责不值一驳。
examples.en: His accusations don't merit a reply.

usage.en: Predicate; dismissive.
usage.zh: 作谓语，语气轻蔑。

meaning.en: Those with no family to rely on: widowers, widows, orphans and the childless elderly.
meaning.zh: 泛指没有劳动力又无依靠的人。

equivalents: those with no one to turn to

examples.zh: 政府要照顾好鳏寡孤独的老人。
examples.en: The government must look after elderly people with no family.

examples.zh: 这家福利院专门收养鳏寡孤独者。
examples.en: The home takes in people who have no kin to rely on.

story.en: Mencius lists the four kinds of people most deserving of a ruler's care: 'old and wifeless are called guan…' (老而无妻曰鳏，老而无夫曰寡，老而无子曰独，幼而无父曰孤).
story.zh: 《孟子》：“老而无妻曰鳏，老而无夫曰寡，老而无子曰独，幼而无父曰孤。此四者，天下之穷民而无告者。”

usage.en: Noun phrase; used in social-welfare contexts.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，多用于社会福利语境。

natural: spread rumours to mislead the public

meaning.en: To invent rumours and mislead people.
meaning.zh: 编造谣言，迷惑群众。

equivalents: spread rumours and mislead the public

examples.zh: 他因造谣惑众被警方拘留。
examples.en: He was detained by the police for spreading rumours.

examples.zh: 网络上造谣惑众的行为必须严惩。
examples.en: Spreading rumours online to mislead people must be dealt with severely.

usage.en: Predicate; common in legal and news contexts.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常见于法律和新闻语境。

meaning.en: Moving quietly and gently, so as not to disturb.
meaning.zh: 动作很轻，怕惊动别人。

examples.zh: 宝宝睡着了，大家轻手轻脚的。
examples.en: The baby's asleep, so everyone is moving quietly.

examples.zh: 他轻手轻脚地关上了门。
examples.en: He closed the door softly.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate.
usage.zh: 作状语、谓语。

natural: sing at the top of one's voice

meaning.en: To raise one's voice in loud, joyful song.
meaning.zh: 放开喉咙，大声唱歌。

examples.zh: 登上山顶，他忍不住引吭高歌。
examples.en: On reaching the summit he couldn't help singing at the top of his voice.

examples.zh: 清晨，百灵鸟在枝头引吭高歌。
examples.en: At dawn a lark sang out from the branch.

usage.en: Predicate; note 吭 is read háng here (throat).
usage.zh: 作谓语；“吭”此处读 háng（喉咙）。

meaning.en: Mountains rising in layer upon layer.
meaning.zh: 山峰重重叠叠，连绵不断。

examples.zh: 车子驶入层峦叠嶂的山区。
examples.en: The car drove into a region of endless ranges.

examples.zh: 远处层峦叠嶂，云雾缭绕。
examples.en: In the distance, ridge upon ridge lay wrapped in mist.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate.
usage.zh: 作定语、谓语。

meaning.en: To lose one's good name late in life.
meaning.zh: 到了晚年，没能保持好名声和节操。

equivalents: fall from grace late in life

examples.zh: 这位官员晚节不保，因受贿被查。
examples.en: The official fell from grace late in life when investigated for bribery.

examples.zh: 他一世清名，却晚节不保。
examples.en: He had a spotless name, but ruined it in his final years.

usage.en: Predicate; contrasts with 保全晚节.
usage.zh: 作谓语，与“保全晚节”相对。

meaning.en: To keep making excuses to avoid doing something.
meaning.zh: 用各种借口推托，不肯照办。

examples.zh: 让他帮个忙，他总是推三阻四。
examples.en: Ask him for a favour and he always makes excuses.

examples.zh: 别再推三阻四了，赶紧动手吧。
examples.en: Stop making excuses and get started.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

pinyin: xíng bǎi lǐ zhě bàn jiǔ shí
literal: walk · hundred · li · person · half · ninety
natural: ninety li is only half of a hundred-li journey

meaning.en: The last stretch is the hardest; do not relax when nearly there.
meaning.zh: 走一百里路的人，走了九十里才算走了一半，比喻事情越接近成功越困难，不可松懈。

equivalents: the last mile is the hardest

examples.zh: 行百里者半九十，越到最后越要坚持。
examples.en: The last stretch is the hardest, so hold on all the more near the end.

examples.zh: 项目快收尾了，行百里者半九十，千万不能松劲。
examples.en: The project is nearly done, but the last part is the hardest, so don't slacken now.

story.en: The Odes are quoted: 'He who walks a hundred li counts ninety as half' (诗云：行百里者半于九十).
story.zh: 《战国策》：“《诗》云：‘行百里者半于九十。’此言末路之难也。”

usage.en: Saying used for encouragement.
usage.zh: 常用来勉励人坚持到底。

meaning.en: Fine, delicate features; good-looking.
meaning.zh: 眉毛清朗，眼睛秀丽，形容容貌清秀。

examples.zh: 那个男孩眉清目秀，十分讨人喜欢。
examples.en: The boy was fine-featured and very endearing.

examples.zh: 她生得眉清目秀，气质温婉。
examples.en: She has delicate features and a gentle manner.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语。
